label: GPT-6.1 Sol
output:
**To my friends, neighbours, Little Acorns families, and everyone this reaches**

First, I’m safe. I’m staying with my sister in Rondebosch, and Marmalade is safe too. Everyone got out of Lindale Court. Two people were treated for smoke inhalation at Groote Schuur and have both been sent home.

If you’ve messaged or called and haven’t heard back, I’m sorry. My phone has hardly stopped since Saturday night. I’ve read so many of your messages, sometimes more than once, and cried at most of them. I’m grateful, but I’m also exhausted and can’t keep telling the story or answering everyone individually. I thought putting everything in one letter might help. Please feel free to forward this to anyone who’s been asking.

The short version is that a fire started at around 11:40pm on Saturday, 7 November, in a ground-floor flat at Lindale Court on Station Road in Obs. There are 14 flats in the block. Mine is Flat 12, on the second floor.

Our neighbour, Uncle Faizel, went along our floor banging on every door in his vest and slippers. That’s how I woke up. I grabbed my phone and Marmalade and got out with nothing else. Marmalade then hid under a car for two hours, because apparently getting a cat out of a burning building is only the first part of the job.

I don’t really want to go through the rest of the night in detail right now. The fire department has said it was probably an electrical fault, but they’re still investigating, and I’m not going to guess at what happened.

My flat has extensive smoke and water damage, and the ceiling came down in the lounge. The landlord says nobody will be able to move back in for at least six weeks. I’m still working out what, if anything, can be saved. For now, I have somewhere safe to sleep, and I’m trying to deal with one thing at a time.

Furniture can be replaced. Marmalade can’t. I keep coming back to that.

**What would actually help**

I find this part difficult. I hate asking for help, and I still feel strange about there being a fundraiser with my name on it. Zinhle has been very firm about me accepting help, so I’m trying to listen.

The things I need most are:

- **Help with a deposit for a new place.** This is the biggest practical worry at the moment.
- **School/work shoes in size 6 and work clothes in size 34.** These specific things would help me get back into my normal school routine.
- **A working laptop.** If anyone has an older one they no longer use, it doesn’t need to be fancy. All my lesson planning was on mine, and having something to work on would make a huge difference.

Please don’t feel you need to buy something new or contribute money you can’t spare. An old laptop that works, or suitable work clothes you already have, would be very welcome.

**What I don’t need right now**

People have been incredibly generous with clothes, and I genuinely have more general clothing than I need already. I’ll pass the extras on to people from the other flats who can use them. Apart from the specific work things above, please hold off on sending more.

I also don’t need food at the moment. My sister’s freezer is full. We are very well fed, and there is only so much room.

I know those offers come from love. Saying “no more food” or “no more clothes” feels ungrateful, but I’d rather be honest about what will help than have people spend money or make trips unnecessarily.

**The fundraiser — and an important warning**

My friend **Zinhle** has set up a BackaBuddy fundraiser for me. The correct link is:

**backabuddy.example/thandi-lindale-court**

The target is **R25 000**, and it had reached **R11 400 this morning**. I’m honestly struggling to find words for that. Thank you to everyone who has donated or shared it.

There is also another page circulating called **“Thandi Fire Relief”**, as well as a WhatsApp message asking people to EFT money to a **Capitec account**. **Neither of those is mine or connected to our fundraiser. I’ve reported it. Please don’t send money to that account or share those appeals.**

If you want to share the fundraiser, please use the exact BackaBuddy link above rather than another page or banking details someone has forwarded. And if you’ve already shared the other appeal in good faith, please send a correction to the same people.

**To the Little Acorns parents**

For anyone who doesn’t know me through school, I teach the Ladybirds, our Grade 00 class at Little Acorns Pre-Primary in Mowbray.

The end-of-year concert on **27 November is still happening**. The 22 crowns and the children’s handprint banner I’d taken home to laminate are gone, which has upset me more than I expected. But please don’t worry: the Ladybirds will have crowns.

I’m back at school on Wednesday. Please don’t make a big thing of it in front of the children. I’m looking forward to seeing them and having a bit of an ordinary school day.

Finally, thank you. To Uncle Faizel, to everyone who helped us get out, to my sister, to Zinhle, and to every person who has checked in or quietly done something useful.

One of my children’s moms left a bag of clothes at my sister’s gate at 7am on Sunday without even knocking. I keep thinking about that kindness.

I’ll reply to comments and messages slowly. Please don’t be offended if I don’t answer your DM. You haven’t said the wrong thing, and I’m not ignoring you. I’m just tired.

Thank you for looking after me.

With love,  
**Thandi**
